messages:
jordan: Heads up: onboarding sample app (Node v0.9.3) prints partial auth tokens and user email when a retry happens. Seen during local run with RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug.

nina: oof. paste a line?

jordan: [ERROR] auth/retry failure id=req-987 token=eyJhbGciOi... user=jane.smith@example.com error=401

pat: that token fragment is bad. our redaction util runs for response bodies but not for thrown errors or unhandled promise rejections.

sam: are we also missing request IDs on these errors? need rw.request_id on spans/logs to correlate.

jordan: yes — logs have `id=req-987` but otel spans have no attribute on stream/ws endpoints. non-HTTP handlers don't run the trace middleware.

nina: quick proposal: default redact rules = email, credit_card, jwt-like tokens (regex), ssn. apply to console/logger output and to error objects before emitting. provide opt-out via `telemetry.redact = false`.

pat: for Otel, add a small wrapper on server.on('connection') to call tracer.startSpan and setAttribute('rw.request_id', header || generated). we should also inject as `loggingContext` so all loggers auto-include it.

sam: agree. small config example for sample app README: 
```json
{
  "telemetry": {
    "redact": true,
    "redact_patterns": ["email", "jwt_token", "ssn"],
    "log_level_env": "RW_LOG_LEVEL",
    "request_id_header": "x-rw-request-id"
  }
}
```

jordan: also recommend default log level = info for sample apps and toggle debug with RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug. tests should assert debug leak only when explicitly enabled.

nina: important: ensure redaction runs before any structured logging serializes the error. i hit this when using pino where error.stack gets stringified after we try to sanitize the object. ordering matters.

pat: I'll add unit tests that simulate auth retry and assert logs contain `[REDACTED]` tokens instead of emails/jwt fragments at INFO/ERROR. Also add an integration smoke that attaches `x-rw-request-id` and checks Otel span attribute `rw.request_id` exists.

sam: thanks. I'll open a PR for node sdk + sample app to: (1) move redaction into logging wrapper, (2) patch retry middleware to pass errors through sanitizer, (3) hook Otel for streaming/ws paths, (4) update README.

devops-bot: created ticket RW-telemetry-607: "sdk/sampleapp: redaction + request_id propagation" assigned to pat/sam

jordan: ETA? we should patch sample app before next onboarding wave to avoid PII leaks in demos.

sam: aiming for patch release this week. will need one quick reviewer. nod from @nina appreciated.

nina: can review after lunch. also let's add a short note in onboarding checklist: "verify RW_LOG_LEVEL not set to debug in demo envs".

jordan: perfect. thanks team.
